sourceEvidence.note: troop 7809 stats.spell.id 9850 "Plated Shell"; ManaCost 11; colours Green+Brown; English "Deal [Magic + 3] damage to a random Enemy, boosted by my Armor. If the Enemy dies, gain 10 Armor. [4:1]" checked verbatim in test.

Spell 9850 Cost 11 Target None; steps: CountArmor Self Amount 25 -> Damage RandomEnemy Amount 3 SPM 1 UseCounterForAmount Delay 1 -> IncreaseArmor Self StatusAmount 10 StatusModifier AddForKill; asserted with toEqual.

Official Brian guide spell list: "boosted by ... Armor" spells carry a Boost Ratio a:1 (e.g. "boosted by all enemy Armor (Boost Ratio 2:1)"), i.e. +1 per a points of the source stat; supports [4:1] = +floor(armor/4) (native CountArmor 25%).
L6B01 troop:7809 describe block: binding + real castSkill Left/Right x Magic 0/10, kill/no-kill, armor 3/4 ratio boundary, dead-enemy exclusion, armor absorption, low-mana, silence.

identity-cost-colors.note: Raw troop 7809 -> spell 9850, ManaCost 11 = native Cost 11, colours Green/Brown; src troops.json manaCost 11, manaColors [Green,Brown], spell.id 9850; ledger binding checks all true.

target-count-range.note: Native Target RandomEnemy -> prototype enemyRandom; test asserts exactly one enemy loses hp and one skill-damage event on both sides; only living enemies are picked (3 defeated -> hits the survivor).

base-formula-rounding.note: Damage = Magic*1 + 3 + counter; Magic 0/10 -> 5/15 with caster armor 10 (counter 2); enemy armor absorbs first (5 dmg vs armor 3 -> armor 0, hp -2).

boost-source-ratio-cap.note: CountArmor Self 25% -> [4:1] modifier on selfStat armor: floor(armor/4) equals floor(armor*25/100) for all integers; armor 3 -> +0, 4 -> +1, 10 -> +2; no CountMax so uncapped.

conditions-probabilities-branches.note: AddForKill: +10 armor only when the damaged enemy dies (ifTargetDied); kill tests both sides give exactly +10 (7->17); survivor tests leave armor unchanged. No probability step.

status-duration-immunity.note: No status step in native 9850 and no status clause in English.

gems-types-selection-resolution.note: No gem step in native 9850; English has no gem clause.

order-death-retargeting.note: Counter read from caster armor before damage (step 0) matches runtime (caster armor unchanged before damage); armor gain happens after the kill; defeated enemies excluded from random pick.

mana-economy-extra-turn.note: Cast spends full 11 mana, logs one action and passes the turn (no extra turn) on both sides; low mana (10) and silence block without consuming mana/action.
